mandate: Response-guided schedule discovery pilot: can LR response dynamics reveal a better training schedule than fixed hand-designed LR rules? Response used as OFFLINE schedule-discovery signal (schedule generated before training); explicitly NOT another online controller (per A0T-extra finding).

inputs_frozen_readonly.chi: outputs/a0o_lr_response_validation_v01/runs/stage1_cells.jsonl h_eta (H==4) for seeds {2030,2031,2037} x steps {46,52,64,82} x streams {7110,7111,7112,7113} = 12 trajectories of 4 knots. Response definition NOT modified, NOT recomputed.
inputs_frozen_readonly.note_d2: A0Q/A0T banks cover only steps {46,82} (2 knots) -> insufficient for trajectories; used only as cross-reference in report, not in schedule construction.

stage1_phase_analysis.trajectory: R(t) = chi_lr(t) per (seed, stream) over knots [46, 52, 64, 82]
frozen_metrics: sign consistency = fraction of knots with chi<0
phases FROZEN: early={46}, middle={52,64}, late={82}: per-phase mean |chi| and mean sign
cross-seed similarity: per stream, Pearson of 4-knot chi vectors across the 3 seed pairs + sign agreement
stage1_phase_analysis.question: does response naturally define training phases? (descriptive; no inferential gate - A0P-negative precedent)

stage2_schedule_rule_frozen.partial_window_rule: R_avg(i) = mean of chi over the up-to-K previous knots (all knots strictly before current); empty set (knot 46) -> KEEP native (multiplier 1.0)
stage2_schedule_rule_frozen.decision: R_avg < 0 -> u=+alpha; R_avg > 0 -> u=-alpha; R_avg == 0 -> keep (unreachable in practice)
stage2_schedule_rule_frozen.no_tuning: K, alpha, segments frozen; no threshold; no adaptive alpha; no future validation loss; no final-loss-based selection

stage3_comparison_frozen.window: rollout from bank state step 46, W=64 optimizer steps (steps 47..110; A0P-proven reach), one 128-micro-batch frozen-recipe stream per cell (derive_stream_seed(stream_seed,404)); nested prefixes NOT needed (single W)
stage3_comparison_frozen.cells: 12 = 3 seeds x 4 streams {7110,7111,7112,7113}, all starting at step 46
stage3_comparison_frozen.crn: arm A rolled twice on every cell; bitwise equality of all 5 checkpoint losses required
stage3_comparison_frozen.rollout_code: new a0u module reusing frozen primitives (pe._restore_and_seed/_baseline_no_step/_clip_and_step, a0g._val_loss_only with RNG wrap + train/eval toggle at checkpoints); LR set as snap['lr']*m BEFORE _clip_and_step, exactly mirroring frozen a0q.run_channel_rollout semantics

optimization: final validation loss at step 110 (all arms)
loss-curve AUC: trapezoid over the 5 checkpoint losses (unnormalized, same spacing -> comparable)
early improvement: L_A(58) - L_X(58) for X in {B,C}
late-stage stability: population std of losses at checkpoints {82, 94, 110}
schedule_properties: number of LR changes (adjacent segments with different multipliers, max 3)
similarity to fixed scaling: fraction of segments with m == 1.05 and count of m == 1.0 segments (C vs B)
cost: schedule generation cost (analyzer wall time, CPU)
training cost (GPU seconds per arm from gpu_budget_log)

statistics_frozen: paired per-cell differences C-A and C-B on final loss and AUC: median, Wilcoxon signed-rank; sign consistency fraction + binomial; arm B vs A reported for reference. Cases: A) response beats fixed AND native (median C-A>0 significant AND C-B>0 significant); B) response ~= fixed (C-B not significant, C-A significant in same direction as B); C) response worse (C-A median < 0 or C significantly below both).

interpretation_cases.case_A: response contains useful phase-dependent optimization information
interpretation_cases.case_B: response discovers simple global scaling direction
interpretation_cases.case_C: local response useful for short-horizon prediction but insufficient for schedule optimization

forbidden: use future validation loss in schedule construction
use final loss to select schedule
limitations_preregistered: IN-SAMPLE schedule: chi at knot t is computed on the same stream the schedule is evaluated on (inherent to frozen bank); no out-of-sample generalization claim
sparse knots: 4 knots/trajectory; K=4 averaging fully materializes only at knot 82
absolute gains tiny (A0S scale G/L0 ~ 7e-5 at H=4)
short-term schedule effect does not imply final-training improvement (A0P long memory)
stop_rule: Stop after experiment. Do not start further controller experiments.
